model_annotation: The bar chart, labeled Figure 10, illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks grouped by language family. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indi, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, with no specific order or scale type indicated. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group representing a language family and containing six bars corresponding to different models, as indicated by the legend: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, colored in distinct hues. The bars vary in height, with some groups showing minimal effect (e.g., IE-Baltic and IE-Germanic, with values around 2-5) and others displaying more substantial effects (e.g., IE-Indi and Semitic, with values ranging from 10-20). Error bars are present on top of each bar, indicating the standard deviation. The chart does not appear to be sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
